## Chrauto AI 0.6.0: scheduled tasks, Viber group messages, new design

### Scheduled tasks that survive restarts
- Schedule an automation for a date and time, save drafts, edit, run now, cancel, retry, and delete.
- Tasks are kept on the phone with their status, attempts, last result, last error, and a full history. They survive the app being closed, the process being killed, reboots, app updates, and time-zone changes.
- Statuses: Draft, Scheduled, Ready, Running, Waiting for device, Waiting for user, Needs attention, Completed, Partially completed, Failed, Cancelled.
- Exact timing uses Android exact alarms when you allow them. Without that permission Android may start a task a few minutes late, and the app says so.
- If the phone is locked or the screen is off at the scheduled time, the task waits ("Waiting for device") and starts when you unlock. After 24 hours of waiting it fails with the reason instead of running at a surprising time.
- Only one task runs at a time; a task can never be started twice.

### Viber group messages (assisted)
- Compose a batch of text and image messages for an existing Viber group, set the time and order, preview, and schedule.
- Chrauto opens Viber's share screen, finds the group by its exact name (it stops if there is no exact, unique match), and checks the chat before and after each message.
- By default you tap Send yourself. With "Tap Send for me" on, Chrauto taps Send once and checks the message appears.
- A message that might have been sent is marked Unconfirmed and is never sent again automatically. You check Viber and mark it Sent or Not sent. A failure stops the rest of the batch so nothing is sent out of order.
- This uses the normal Viber app on your phone. It is not an official Viber bot or API, and it has not yet been tested on a real phone.

### New look
- A smaller, more professional agent mark replaces the cartoon mascot in the app, launcher icon, floating control, and on-screen cursor.
- Restrained light and dark themes that follow the phone setting, 48 dp touch targets, and calmer animations.
- A clearer home screen: readiness chips, the task box, the current run, scheduled tasks, Chron, and settings.

### Reliability and safety
- Reading the screen no longer blocks the UI thread.
- Stop now cuts off a pending AI request immediately instead of waiting for it to time out.
- The "nothing changed, tap again" fallback is skipped for Send, Pay, Delete, Post and similar buttons, so they are never tapped twice.
- If the accessibility service is turned off during a run, the run fails with that reason instead of showing "Stopped".
